results: Search found generic inspector courses/VR training and industrial competency platforms, but no clear direct product centered on capturing real expert inspection decisions, trainee decisions, rationale and competency history as reusable case coaching.

Search found broad manufacturing change/action and MES platforms, but no clear direct product matching external-development intake, applicability-to-plant/supplier, owner assignment and closure evidence as the core workflow.
Docsy, Agora, ARGOS, Othento and ID-Pal directly cover identity/KYC verification exceptions, remediation queues, review and evidence.

SupplyPass, QualityAI, Cloudtheapp and SAP supplier qualification/readiness products cover qualification evidence, capability/readiness and supplier workflows; proposed semiconductor specialization is insufficiently distinct.
Siemens ReqTracer, Altium, Visure and related requirements/V&V platforms directly provide requirement-to-verification evidence, traceability and audit packages.
